mc.item.ItemBlock.name: net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem
mc.item.ItemBlock.note: BlockItem 构造需要 (Block, Item.Properties)，签名与 1.12 的 ItemBlock 不同

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: BlockEntity 构造需要 (BlockEntityType, BlockPos, BlockState)，且需注册 BlockEntityType

mc.core.RayTraceResult.name: net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult
mc.core.RayTraceResult.note: HitResult 已拆分为 BlockHitResult / EntityHitResult 子类，按用途选择

mc.chat.Component.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.Component
mc.chat.Component.note: 1.18.2 没有 Component.literal/translatable 静态工厂：字面文本用 new TextComponent(...)，翻译键用 new TranslatableComponent(...)（均返回 MutableComponent 子类）

mc.chat.HoverEvent.name: net.minecraft.network.chat.HoverEvent
mc.chat.HoverEvent.note: HoverEvent 构造改为 (HoverEvent.Action<T>, T)，Action 常量为泛型

mc.util.InteractionResultHolder.name: net.minecraft.world.InteractionResultHolder
mc.util.InteractionResultHolder.note: InteractionResultHolder<T> 为泛型，静态工厂 success/pass/fail

mc.effect.MobEffect.name: net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect
mc.effect.MobEffect.note: 1.12 的 Potion(效果) 对应 MobEffect；药水物品类型是 net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potion，勿混淆

mc.particles.ParticleTypes.name: net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes
mc.particles.ParticleTypes.note: 粒子常量名与 1.12 的 EnumParticleTypes 不同（如 SMOKE_NORMAL -> SMOKE），API 改为 ParticleOptions

mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.name: net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu
mc.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu.note: Container -> AbstractContainerMenu：需注册 MenuType 并配合 NetworkHooks.openGui 打开（1.19 才改名 openScreen）

mc.inventory.Container.name: net.minecraft.world.Container
mc.inventory.Container.note: IInventory -> Container（接口）；模组自身容器推荐改用 IItemHandler/ItemStackHandler 能力

mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: GuiScreen -> Screen：渲染改用 PoseStack，控件/输入 API 全面变化，需人工重写渲染与交互代码

mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen
mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.note: GuiContainer -> AbstractContainerScreen<T extends AbstractContainerMenu>，渲染方法签名全变

mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.name: net.minecraft.client.renderer.blockentity.BlockEntityRenderer
mc.client.BlockEntityRenderer.note: TESR -> BlockEntityRenderer<T> 接口，render 签名为 (T, float, PoseStack, MultiBufferSource, int, int)，在 EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers 注册

forge.NetworkHooks.name: net.minecraftforge.network.NetworkHooks
forge.NetworkHooks.note: 1.18.2 打开菜单的方法叫 openGui（1.19 才改名 openScreen）

forge.capabilities.Capability.name: net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.Capability
forge.capabilities.Capability.note: 1.18.2 中 getCapability 返回 LazyOptional<T>，需用 .orElse(...) / .ifPresent(...) 解包

forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.name: net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider
forge.capabilities.ICapabilityProvider.note: getCapability(cap, side) 返回 LazyOptional<T>，hasCapability 已移除

forge.capabilities.CapabilityManager.name: net.minecraftforge.common.capabilities.CapabilityManager
forge.capabilities.CapabilityManager.note: 注册方式改为 CapabilityManager.get(new CapabilityToken<>(){}) + RegisterCapabilitiesEvent（@CapabilityInject 已于 1.17 移除）

forge.fluids.FluidStack.name: net.minecraftforge.fluids.FluidStack
forge.fluids.FluidStack.note: FluidStack 现在包装 net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid（原版流体），构造与 1.12 的 Fluid 不同

forge.fluids.FluidTank.name: net.minecraftforge.fluids.capability.templates.FluidTank
forge.fluids.FluidTank.note: FluidTank 移至 capability.templates 包，构造参数为 (capacity[, validator])

forge.lifecycle.commonSetup.name: net.minecraftforge.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent
forge.lifecycle.commonSetup.note: FMLCommonSetupEvent 需通过 Mod 事件总线监听；注册类内容应改用 DeferredRegister 而不是在此事件中注册

forge.lifecycle.init.name: net.minecraftforge.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLCommonSetupEvent
forge.lifecycle.init.note: 1.12 的 init 阶段与 preInit 在新版中合并为 FMLCommonSetupEvent，注意两个方法可能合并

forge.lifecycle.loadComplete.name: net.minecraftforge.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLLoadCompleteEvent
forge.lifecycle.loadComplete.note: FMLLoadCompleteEvent 需通过 Mod 事件总线监听

forge.lifecycle.serverStarting.name: net.minecraftforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent
forge.lifecycle.serverStarting.note: ServerStartingEvent 在 Forge 总线（MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS）上监听，用 @SubscribeEvent

forge.lifecycle.serverStopping.name: net.minecraftforge.event.server.ServerStoppingEvent
forge.lifecycle.serverStopping.note: ServerStoppingEvent 在 Forge 总线（MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS）上监听，用 @SubscribeEvent

forge.event.RegisterEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.event.RegistryEvent
forge.event.RegisterEvent.note: 1.18.2 仍使用 RegistryEvent.Register<T>（Mod 总线）：@SubscribeEvent public static void register(RegistryEvent.Register<Item> e) { e.getRegistry().register(...) }；1.19 起才改为 RegisterEvent。也可改用 DeferredRegister（两版均可用）

forge.event.EntityJoinLevelEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.event.entity.EntityJoinWorldEvent
forge.event.EntityJoinLevelEvent.note: 1.18.2 名为 EntityJoinWorldEvent，取世界用 getWorld()；1.19 起改名 EntityJoinLevelEvent/getLevel()

forge.event.PlayerEventFml.name: net.minecraftforge.event.entity.player.PlayerEvent
forge.event.PlayerEventFml.note: 1.12 的 gameevent.PlayerEvent（登录/登出/合成/拾取）已并入 event.entity.player.PlayerEvent 的内部类

forge.event.BlockEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.event.world.BlockEvent
forge.event.BlockEvent.note: 1.18.2 位于 net.minecraftforge.event.world 包（1.19 起移到 event.level），取世界用 getWorld()

forge.event.InputEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.InputEvent
forge.event.InputEvent.note: InputEvent 位于 client.event 包；1.18.2 内部类为 KeyInputEvent / MouseInputEvent / MouseScrollEvent（1.19 起改名为 InputEvent.Key / MouseButton 等）

forge.event.ScreenEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.ScreenEvent
forge.event.ScreenEvent.note: 1.18.2 已叫 ScreenEvent，但内部类命名与 1.19 不同（如 InitScreenEvent / DrawScreenEvent，1.19 为 ScreenEvent.Init / Render），需逐个核对

forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderGameOverlayEvent
forge.event.RenderGuiOverlayEvent.note: 1.18.2 名为 RenderGameOverlayEvent，判别用 getType() == ElementType.XXX；1.19 起改为 RenderGuiOverlayEvent + VanillaGuiOverlay id

forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.name: net.minecraftforge.client.event.RenderLevelLastEvent
forge.event.RenderLevelStageEvent.note: 1.18.2 名为 RenderLevelLastEvent（单一时机）；1.19 起改为 RenderLevelStageEvent，需判断 getStage() == Stage.AFTER_LEVEL 等

mc.core.registries.Registries.name: net.minecraft.core.Registry
mc.core.registries.Registries.note: 1.18 注册表键与静态注册表都在 net.minecraft.core.Registry（1.19.3 起才拆分为 Registries / BuiltInRegistries）

mc.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.name: net.minecraft.core.Registry
mc.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries.note: 1.18 注册表键与静态注册表都在 net.minecraft.core.Registry（1.19.3 起才拆分为 Registries / BuiltInRegistries）
